source.title: Ulster Herald, 21 September 1946, p. 5 ("Tyrone-Fermanagh bodies divided: L.C. elections")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the unopposed nominations read in the Ulster Herald of 21 September 1946, p. 5; the Longfield vacancy notice in the same paper of 5 October 1946, p. 3.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. There was no contest: three seats formerly held by Nationalists were returned unopposed to Unionist candidates, and the new council was expected to consist of 16 Unionists and three Nationalists. Longfield had no candidate and was left as a casual vacancy. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
